    s=np.sin(w*t); cc=np.cos(w*t)
    return b*t + c*P*np.log(P) + (d + e*t + f*np.log(t) + g*t*t + h*t*np.log(t) + (k + m*t)*s + 0.0*cc)/P + 0.0*cc
